name: STC Bank
legal_name: STC Bank (closed mixed joint-stock company; formerly Saudi Digital Payments Company, operator of the stc pay wallet)
founded: Established Nov 2017 as a digital-payments company (stc pay); SAMA e-wallet licence 2020 (Western Union acquired 15% the same year); Council of Ministers digital-bank licence decision no. 671 of 22 Jun 2021 (capital SAR 2.5bn); SAMA no-objection to commence banking operations 28 Jan 2025; commercial launch Feb 2025.
ownership_summary: Unlisted closed mixed joint-stock company with SAR 6,350m paid-up capital. stc group (Saudi Telecom Company, Tadawul-listed; 62% held by the Public Investment Fund at 31 Dec 2025) held 92.26% at 31 Dec 2025, up from 87.73% in 2024 after it injected SAR 3,000m of new capital (approved 30 Dec 2024). The other shareholders are not named in the bank's or stc's published documents; Western Union acquired 15% in 2020 and still sits on the board (see people), but its current percentage is not disclosed.

shareholders.holder: stc group (Saudi Telecom Company; Tadawul-listed, 62% Public Investment Fund per stc AR 2025)
Other shareholders (not named; residual after stc's 92.26%, our derivation). Western Union bought 15% in 2020; its current holding is not disclosed.

government_link: Yes, indirect: majority-owned by stc group, which is 62% owned by the Public Investment Fund (Saudi sovereign wealth fund) at 31 Dec 2025 (stc AR 2025, S7). Licensed by Cabinet decision and supervised by SAMA. Checked 2026-10-12.
group_structure: Subsidiary of stc group, consolidated in stc's financial statements (stc AR 2025 note 12). STC Bank is reported inside stc group's 'Digital' theme alongside sirar, IoT squared, Channels, sccc and solutions. stc group states that an IPO of subsidiaries including STC Bank is part of its strategy but not expected within one year of Jul 2026 (S9). No standalone STC Bank financial statements or Pillar 3 report were found, so bank-level balance-sheet metrics below come from stc group's consolidated disclosures and carry that caveat.
footprint: Saudi Arabia only; digital-only (services delivered through the STC Bank app and web; no branch network found on the official site). Head office Ad Diriyah, Riyadh (S3). Checked 2026-10-12.
customer_segments: Retail customers (Classic, Plus, Premium and Elite tiers set by 3-month average balance), SMEs and merchants (business accounts, POS, e-commerce, SME financing). stc pay wallet users were migrated to bank accounts. No private-banking proposition found.
business_lines: Personal: current accounts, Visa debit/credit/prepaid cards, Smart Saver (Mudarabah), fixed deposits (1/3/6/12 months, Mudarabah), Multiplier Account (prize-linked), Personal Finance and Smart Finance, international transfers, STC Bank Market (offers/cashback). Business: business accounts, POS and e-commerce acceptance, SME financing (POS financing, capex financing, working-capital financing). Lending started in 2025-2026 (S9). No investment, brokerage, funds or wealth product found on the website (checked 2026-10-12).

capabilities.wealth_summary: STC Bank is a mass-market retail and SME digital bank (8.5m+ customers at H1 2026) whose investment-type offer is limited to Shariah-structured savings: Smart Saver (Mudarabah, expected profit 0% below SAR 1,000 rising to 5.00% at SAR 500,000+, round-up and auto-save), fixed deposits of 1/3/6/12 months, a prize-linked Multiplier Account and a Numu+ rewards savings offer. Balance-based tiers (Classic; Plus from SAR 25,000; Premium from SAR 50,000; Elite from SAR 200,000 average 3-month balance) give Visa Classic/Platinum/Signature cards, cashback, lounge access and 24/7 concierge at Elite. No brokerage, funds, advisory, managed-portfolio or private-banking offer was found on the website (checked 12 Oct 2026). In Apr 2025 the then-CEO told Bloomberg that loans and 'investment products' would follow later in 2025; no such investment product was found live. stc group's Q2 2026 release speaks of growth in the bank's 'deposits and investment portfolio' without defining the latter.

private_banking.detail: No private-banking proposition; the top tier, Elite, starts at SAR 200,000 average balance and offers card, transfer and concierge benefits only.

asset_management.detail: No asset-management entity or own-branded fund found for STC Bank. Group investment activity sits with stc group's investment unit and venture funds (STV), which are not bank products.

brokerage.detail: No share-trading or brokerage feature on the website or in stc group materials.

digital_investing.detail: App offers savings and deposits only; the homepage lists no investment, funds, gold or shares product (checked 12 Oct 2026). Apr 2025 plan to add investment products (S19) not seen live.

discretionary.detail: No discretionary or managed portfolio found.

islamic_wealth.detail: The whole bank is Shariah-governed (three-scholar Shariah Committee; Mudarabah savings and fixed deposits) but no Shariah-compliant funds, portfolios or sukuk offer was found; Islamic features are deposit products.

partners.what: Temenos Core (accounts, lending, deposits, collections) on PostgreSQL, live since 14 Feb 2022; on-site first-level support; Fast Track Growth award in 2025. Vendor's own account.
Regional partner that supported the Temenos implementation
Bought 15% of the company in 2020 (USD 200m per Bloomberg via Enterprise, SAR 750m per Argaam); head of Strategy sits on the board
Visa Classic, Platinum and Signature cards are tied to the Plus, Premium and Elite tiers
Announced integration so that pay-from-STC-Bank-account is available to 80,000 Salla online stores

initiatives.what: Cabinet approved licensing two local digital banks: STC Bank (stc pay converted, SAR 2.5bn capital) and Saudi Digital Bank (SAR 1.5bn)
Extraordinary General Assembly raised paid-up capital to SAR 6,350m; stc injected SAR 3,000m, lifting its stake to 92.26%
SAMA gave no objection to STC Bank commencing banking operations as a digital bank; commercial launch followed in Feb 2025
CEO told Bloomberg the full suite, including loans and investment products for large companies, SMEs and retail, would launch later in 2025; stc had provided USD 800m of cash before launch
Mohammed Al-Fraih appointed Acting CEO after Nizar Altwaijri stepped down in Jul 2025
FY2025: 15+ products launched since Feb 2025 across accounts, payments and financing; 8m+ customers; 90% increase in app downloads

H1 2026 results: 8.5m+ customers; lending products launched; revenue SAR 792m (+13.8%); stc expects the bank to need more capital over the next three to five years and says no subsidiary IPO is expected within a year

opportunities: 8.5m+ customers at H1 2026 with a savings-only product set (Smart Saver, fixed deposits, prize-linked Multiplier) and no investment product on the site (S2, S5, S8).
Management stated in Apr 2025 that investment products would be added after launch; none found live by 12 Oct 2026 (S19).
Balance-based tiers (Plus SAR 25,000, Premium SAR 50,000, Elite SAR 200,000) create an identifiable affluent base inside the app (S4).
stc expects to inject more capital and describes deposit growth as a 2026 priority (S9, S7).
barriers: Shariah-governed bank: any shelf must be Shariah-screened and approved by the three-scholar Shariah Committee (S1).
stc group controls strategy (92.26%) and board seats; five of ten directors hold stc group executive roles (S1, S7).
Leadership in transition: acting CEO since Aug 2025; no executive team or digital/product head listed on the official site (S1, S15).
stc expects the bank to need more capital over the next three to five years, and no standalone financials or profit figure are published (S9, S8).

discrepancies.field: stc group ownership of STC Bank
discrepancies.detail: Argaam (28 Jan 2025) says stc holds 85% and Western Union 15%; stc's FY2025 annual report says stc held 92.26% at 31 Dec 2025 (87.73% at end-2024) after capital injections in which Western Union evidently did not participate.
discrepancies.resolution: Used stc AR 2025 (tier 1). The 85% figure matches the 2020 position after Western Union's purchase; later capital increases raised stc's share.

discrepancies.detail: stc AR 2025 chart shows STC Bank revenue of SAR 1,262m for 2024; Bloomberg data cited by Enterprise gives SAR 345m 'gross income' for 2024.
discrepancies.resolution: Unresolved; the definitions probably differ (group-reported revenue versus bank gross income). Recorded the stc figure with status 'Conflicting sources'.

discrepancies.detail: SAMA's digital banks page still shows STC Bank as 'Licensed - has not started yet' although SAMA gave no-objection to commence operations on 28 Jan 2025.
discrepancies.resolution: Used the 2025 launch evidence; SAMA register page is stale.

discrepancies.detail: A Bloomberg-sourced figure of about 1.5 million customers (early 2025, search-result snippet only) versus 8m+ at end-2025 and 8.5m+ at H1 2026 in stc's reports. The base likely includes migrated stc pay wallet users (the transformation notice upgrades wallets to accounts); the definition of customer is not stated.
discrepancies.resolution: Used stc-reported figures with the caveat that active versus registered is not stated.

open_items: No standalone STC Bank financial statements, Pillar 3 report, total assets, loan book or net profit were found; stc group's H1 2026 financial statements on Saudi Exchange returned HTTP 403, so the 30 Jun 2026 deposit-type balance is not recorded. Check the Tadawul disclosure for stc (7010) via a permitted route.

CEO status: Mohammed Al-Fraih was Acting CEO from Aug 2025; a hrtoday.in headline (blocked) says he was appointed CEO. Confirm the date of the permanent appointment from a SAMA no-objection notice, a Tadawul disclosure or STC Bank's own news.
Official team page lists no management beyond the Corporate Affairs CEO. No chief digital, product, retail or savings/investment head found; Temenos names Mansour Al-Zharani as CTO (undated).
No LinkedIn checks run beyond the CEO (search budget used on ownership, financials and launch evidence).

Numu+ savings offer: seen only as a search-result snippet and a Zawya title ('stc bank launches numu savings product'); the Zawya page returned Page Not Found when opened, so date and terms are unverified and it is not listed in initiatives.
